belize.title: Flag of Belize

colors.note: Central royal blue field; represents the People's United Party and the Caribbean Sea.
Two horizontal stripes at top and bottom; represents the United Democratic Party.
Circular field bearing the coat of arms; represents peace.

desc:
- A royal blue field with narrow red horizontal stripes at the top and bottom, and the national coat of arms on a white disc at the centre
- The coat of arms features two loggers flanking a mahogany tree beneath the motto Sub Umbra Floreo (Under the Shade I Flourish)
- Adopted on 21 September 1981, the day Belize gained independence from the United Kingdom
trivia:
- Belize's flag is the only national flag to depict human beings as a primary design element
- The red stripes were added at independence to represent the opposition UDP alongside the ruling PUP, a gesture of national unity
- The fifty leaves surrounding the shield commemorate the People's Committee formed in 1950 that led to independence
